title: Author and test a lifecycle hook
steps: Choose a native event from the 17-value HookEvent set. Do not copy foreign event names.
Configure executable/argv, allowlisted environment, deadline, stdout/stderr caps and failure policy.
Admit a bounded test under the real capability/deadline envelope; no production event is emitted merely to preview input.
Inspect verdict, exit state and bounded output.
Save only a validated version for future events; cite the exact spec version, event, envelope and audit artifact.
forbidden_fake_states: Partial output after timeout shown as Allow
test run emitting a real production lifecycle event
complete_when: a hook run cites exact spec version, event, envelope and bounded audit artifact (p.185).
